text:
Jordan (customer): Hey @support — trying to apply code TRIAL-2025 on our org (org_1245) for jane@acme.com and getting "invalid or expired" from the API, but the promo dashboard shows it as active. Can someone check?
Emma (support): Sorry about that — can you paste the exact code you used + the org id and a screenshot if you have one? Also when did you sign up?
Jordan (customer): Code: TRIAL-2025, org: org_1245, signed up today ~10:15am PST. Screenshot: https://files.redwood.internal/snap/abc.png
Emma (support): Thanks. Can you also paste the API response body and any headers like X-Request-Id or trace id? If easier run:
```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/promos/redeem \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' \
  -d '{"code":"TRIAL-2025","org_id":"org_1245"}'
```
Jordan (customer): Response: HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
{"error":"promo_invalid","detail":"code expired"}
Headers: x-request-id: abc123def
Emma (support): Got it — escalating to billing + eng. /cc @Liam (billing) @Devon (eng) :eyes:
support-bot: New support ticket created (#SUP-4521) for org_1245 — assigned to Emma.
Liam (billing): Looking into the ledger. The promo TRIAL-2025 shows remaining redemptions and no expiry in the promo config (expires_at: 2025-12-31T23:59:59Z). The system received a 400 though — was it a 410 or 400?
Emma (support): Jordan saw 400 with body saying expired (shared above).
Devon (eng): Pulling logs for x-request-id=abc123def. I can see the claim-service returned promo_invalid -> expired. Raw log snippet: 
```
2025-07-16T17:04:12Z claim-service[worker-3]: validate_promo code=TRIAL-2025 org=org_1245 user=jane@acme.com now=2025-07-16T17:04:12Z expires_at=2025-07-16T23:59:59-07:00 result=expired
```
Devon (eng): Preliminary root cause: expiry was stored with a -07:00 offset (customer local tz) but when cached, the expires_at was serialized without TZ and later parsed as UTC during a deploy window where clocks and cache entries were briefly out-of-sync. That made the now > expires_at check true for some requests.
Devon (eng): Quick repro: create org in America/Los_Angeles, set promo expires 23:59 local, then redeem during the DST transition deploy window -> returns expired. Not many accounts affected.
Emma (support): Can we give Jordan the credit while you patch?
Liam (billing): I'll issue a manual trial credit of $200 to org_1245 now. Transaction id MANUAL-789. Jordan, you should see the credit in Billing > Credits in ~5-10 minutes.
Jordan (customer): I can confirm the credit showed up. Thank you! :relieved:
Devon (eng): We're preparing a hotfix to normalize expiry timestamps to UTC on write/read and add an integration test for cache serialization. Deploy scheduled for 20:00 UTC today. We'll also enqueue a backfill job to retry any failed redemptions in the affected window.
Emma (support): I'll update the ticket and proactively message the ~12 customers who saw this during the deploy window.
Jordan (customer): Appreciate the fast help — thanks everyone :tada:
Liam (billing): Logged manual credit in ledger and sent receipt to jane@acme.com. Ticket SUP-4521 updated.
Devon (eng): Post-mortem note: root cause = cache serialization timezone loss during rolling deploy + expiry check logic assuming parsed time is UTC. Fix: always store expires_at in RFC3339Z (UTC) and add guardrails.
Emma (support): Closing loop here — if Jordan sees any further issues, please reopen the thread or reply to the ticket.
Jordan (customer): All good for now, thanks again!
